$DRVN filed an NT 10-Q on Nov 6, delaying its Q3 report to restate 2024 and 2025 financials. How do you read it — 1) routine 2) material 3) wait and see? #8K #SEC
Charts: $DRVN Q2 2026 (10-Q filed 2026-08-06). Read automatically from the filings; not investment advice.
$SKYD: cash came in ahead of profit — operating cash flow of $123M topped net earnings. Q3 revenue $7.0B with a 5.2% operating margin. 👇 #earnings #media
$KKR: revenue growth slowed to −17% from +12% the quarter before. Q3 revenue $4.6B, operating margin 33.1%, net earnings $1.2B. 👇 #earnings #finance
$BTGO: revenue fell 51% to $2.9B in Q3, but net earnings rose to $44M as non-operating items boosted the bottom line. 👇 #earnings #finance
$GMRS: profit grew faster than sales — operating profit +21% to $0.26B on revenue of $1.6B (+6% Y/Y). Q3 margins expanded to 16.4%. 👇 #earnings #industrials
$TTWO: revenue fell 16% to $1.5B in Q2 FY27, with an operating margin of -7.8% and a net loss of $54M amid a quiet release schedule. 👇 #earnings #software
$LINE: still losing money — Q3 revenue $1.4B (-1% Y/Y) with an operating margin of -5.9% and a net loss of $173M. 👇 #earnings #REITs
$VRMK: still losing money — revenue +56% to $1.2B, but operating margin at −72.4% on merger costs and higher depreciation. Net loss hit $747M. 👇 #earnings #REITs
$KMPR: revenue fell 12% to $1.1B, but profit turned positive as net income reached $52M on a 5.9% operating margin. 👇 #earnings #insurance
$IHRT: podcast growth outpaced the top line — revenue +3% to $1.0B, operating margin 7.1%. Podcast delivered more than the total revenue gain. 👇 #earnings #media
